task: Add three lifecycle gates around Proofbound's existing dev-memory system (currently 100% voluntary/best-effort): a hard INIT_CHECK-phase preflight-acknowledgement requirement before DEV, a non-blocking advisory reminder on finding_resolve, and a hard DONE-gate finish-decision requirement.
outcome: A story cannot enter DEV (via any of the four DEV-entry doors) without dev_memory_preflight_ack having been recorded; finding_resolve's output includes a short non-blocking advisory line suggesting dev_memory_capture when relevant; a story cannot reach DONE without dev_memory_finish_decision having been recorded (captured|no-reusable-lesson|defer-with-reason all satisfy it).
facts: DEV-entry is gated by four separate xstate guard functions in core/machine.ts, not one choke point: canStartDevGuard (637-669, PLAN->DEV), canSkipPlanGuard (697-717, INIT_CHECK->DEV express), canReenterDevGuard (728-738, REVIEW/TEST->DEV rollback)
Each boolean guard has a byte-matched human-readable twin in getGuardFailureReason (1130+); boolean and message must be kept in sync by hand, there is no shared array/data structure enforcing parity
canFinishGuard (876-943, the DONE gate) is a sequential list of if(...) return false early-returns, not an array of pluggable checks

The existing scope_boundary_set/execution_boundary_set/scope_freeze_check INIT_CHECK-gating pattern (handlers/scope-anti-expansion.ts + core/machine.ts:286-378 evaluateScopeAntiExpansionGate) is the direct precedent for CHK-001
finding_resolve (handlers/finding.ts:759-791) already has a precedent for appending non-blocking advisory text: the commitHint suffix via autoCommitStoryMetadata

dev_memory_finish_decision currently writes to .lattice/dev-memory/finish-decisions/<storyId>.json via raw fs calls in handlers/playbook-runtime-memory.ts, with finishDecisionPath not exported -- must be moved to core/playbook-runtime-memory.ts to avoid a core-importing-from-handlers inversion in machine.ts

dev_memory_finish_decision's record has no _hash/material-binding field, unlike scope-boundary.json/delivery-check.json -- the simple existence-check pattern (canFinishGuard's test-evidence check, 877-882) is the correct model to follow, not the hash/staleness pattern (delivery-check)
constraints: The finding_resolve reminder must be non-blocking and must never change finding_resolve's exit code or fail the call, even if the memory subsystem throws -- wrap in try/catch
No minimum-count or positive-capture requirement for the DONE gate -- an honest no-reusable-lesson decision must be a fully valid, non-blocking answer
Must not modify dev_memory_capture/dev_memory_finish/dev_memory_preflight's existing core logic or schema beyond what's needed for the new acknowledgement/decision-tracking artifacts
Must not touch playbooks.json/signature-registry.json or the global (~/.lattice) dev-memory scope
The CHK-001 gate must apply uniformly to all four DEV-entry doors, not just PLAN->DEV, since a gameable implementation that only checks one door would defeat the purpose
unknowns: Exact RuntimeConsumer wiring details for finding_resolve's advisory (core/playbook-runtime-memory.ts:44-52 union, and whether it needs registration in any other lookup table) -- to be confirmed during implementation by reading the full file
Whether any existing test fixture already builds a full story lifecycle from INIT through DONE that the new smoke test can reuse/adapt, versus needing a from-scratch fixture
touchpoints: packages/main/src/handlers/playbook-runtime-memory.ts (dev_memory_finish_decision import from core instead of local definition)
